newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold prices little changed, volume slips.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold prices little changed, volume slips.

text.p: Traded volume on the Istanbul gold exchange slipped to 1,789 kilos on Tuesday, from Monday's 2,076 kilos, with prices little moved.
Gold ended at $335.00 an ounce unchanged from Monday's close, but fell slightly in lira terms to 1,597,300 per gram, versus the previous 1,599,300 lira.
Dealers said lower prices boosted physical demand from jewellers.
"Perhaps one or two deals were due to arbitrage by the banks, but apart from that nearly all the day's trade was due to physical demand from the free market," one dealer said.
The Turkish lira was weaker on Tuesday, closing at 148,670 to the dollar, compared to 148,360 on Monday.
Most of the day's trade -- 1,689 kilos -- took place in the morning session with 64.2 percent of the total volume conducted in lira terms. No lira deals were made in the afternoon session.
